_comment: The graph Studio sends to a ComfyUI server: a plain SDXL text-to-image pass, in the API
format the editor writes with 'Save (API Format)' under Dev mode. It is one KSampler, one
checkpoint, an empty latent, two text encoders and a save — deliberately the smallest graph
that is still a real picture, because a graph nobody can read is a graph nobody will fix
when their checkpoint is called something else.
Studio fills it in by following the sampler's own links rather than by assuming these node
numbers, so a graph you export yourself and name in the config's `workflow` works too, and
anything it could not fill is reported rather than silently ignored.
